sections.title: Coffee and breakfast
sections.lede: Most of these are an easy walk. Wyatt’s and Maude’s are closest.

places.name: Wyatt's Coffee
places.desc: Independent cafe downtown: espresso, pour-over and pastries.

places.name: Maude's Classic Cafe
places.desc: Coffee, tea, desserts and sandwiches beside the Hippodrome, with board games and an outdoor terrace.

places.name: Afternoon
places.desc: Brunch spot known for its Dutch baby and shakshuka. Check the days before you go.

places.name: Afternoon Coffee
places.desc: Small coffee bar on South Main, handy on the way to Depot Park.

places.name: Opus Coffee
places.desc: Local roaster's cafe at Innovation Square, between downtown and campus.

places.name: Baker Baker
places.desc: Family-run bakeshop at the 4th Avenue Food Park. Mornings only, so go early.

sections.title: Lunch and dinner
sections.lede: Downtown’s restaurants are within ten minutes on foot. Book ahead on game and graduation weekends.

places.name: The Top
places.desc: Downtown New American restaurant since 2000. Dinner nightly and Sunday brunch.

places.name: Dragonfly Sushi & Sake
places.desc: Sushi and Japanese small plates. Takes reservations, which helps on big weekends.

places.name: Harry's Seafood Bar & Grille
places.desc: New Orleans-style seafood, downtown since 1994.

places.name: OAK
places.desc: Southern comfort food with self-serve beer taps and a Friday brunch.

places.name: Boca Fiesta
places.desc: Tacos, margaritas and fresh lemonade. Lunch on weekends.

places.name: Liquid Ginger
places.desc: Asian fusion: pad thai, curries and bento boxes.

places.name: Kyuramen
places.desc: Ramen and milk tea in the Hyatt Place building.

places.name: Flaco's Cuban Bakery
places.desc: Cuban sandwiches, arepas and bowls, open late most nights.

places.name: Satchel's Pizza
places.desc: Local favorite pizza place with famously eclectic decor. Tuesday through Saturday.

places.name: The Swamp Restaurant
places.desc: Gator-themed sports restaurant about 20 minutes on foot from the stadium.

places.name: Mildred's Big City Food
places.desc: Upscale American and seafood since 1994. Book ahead for a graduation dinner.

sections.title: Breweries and cocktails
sections.lede: Cocktail bars a few blocks away, and three local breweries.

places.name: Cry Baby's
places.desc: Cocktail bar with food on the corner of University and Main.

places.name: Kin Cocktail Bar
places.desc: Craft cocktail lounge downtown. Closed Mondays.

places.name: The Bull
places.desc: Beer and wine pub with live music most nights.

places.name: Cypress & Grove Brewing
places.desc: Brewery in a former ice factory, open daily from 2 pm.

places.name: First Magnitude Brewing
places.desc: Brewery with a big beer garden and food trucks, beside the Hawthorne Trail.

places.name: Swamp Head Brewery
places.desc: Gainesville's original craft brewery (2008), with a large outdoor area and food trucks.

sections.title: Things to do
sections.lede: Museums, theater and Florida outdoors, from a four-minute walk to a twenty-minute drive.

places.name: Union Street Farmers Market
places.address: Bo Diddley Plaza, 111 E University Ave, Gainesville, FL
places.desc: Wednesdays 4 to 7 pm, rain or shine. Bring cash.

places.name: Hippodrome Theatre
places.desc: Professional theater in the old federal building.

places.name: Matheson History Museum
places.desc: Free museum of local history, Wednesday through Saturday.

places.name: Historic Thomas Center
places.desc: 1910s Mediterranean Revival hotel turned city galleries, with gardens to wander.

places.name: Depot Park
places.desc: City park with a big playground, a splash pad, trails and ponds.

places.name: Cade Museum
places.desc: Hands-on science and invention museum at Depot Park, Thursday through Sunday.

places.name: Florida Museum of Natural History
places.desc: Fossils, Florida wildlife and the Butterfly Rainforest. Scheduled to reopen November 23, 2026, after renovation.

places.name: Harn Museum of Art
places.desc: Free UF art museum next door to the natural history museum. Open late on Thursdays.

places.name: UF Bat Houses at Lake Alice
places.desc: Free. Thousands of bats fly out about 15 to 20 minutes after sunset on warm, calm evenings.

places.name: Sweetwater Wetlands Park
places.desc: Boardwalk through a restored wetland: birds and alligators. $5 per car.

places.name: Paynes Prairie Preserve State Park
places.desc: Wide-open prairie with wild bison, horses and alligators.

places.name: Devil's Millhopper
places.desc: A 120-foot sinkhole with a boardwalk of 132 steps down into it.

sections.title: Groceries and pharmacies
sections.lede: For stocking the kitchen and anything you forgot.

places.name: Publix
places.desc: The nearest full supermarket, with a pharmacy.

places.name: Ward's Supermarket
places.desc: Independent family grocer since 1951: local produce and a meat counter.

places.name: Walgreens
places.desc: Store open until midnight; pharmacy until 9 pm on weekdays.

places.name: CVS Pharmacy (24 hours)
places.desc: Listed as open 24 hours. Call ahead at 352-336-3383.
